title: [NEXT-644] cookies broke on 13.2.1 Invariant: Method expects to have requestAsyncStorage, none available

labels.name: bug
labels.description: Issue was opened via the bug report template.

labels.name: linear: next
labels.description: Confirmed issue that is tracked by the Next.js team.

body:
### Verify canary release - [X] I verified that the issue exists in the latest Next.js canary release ### Provide environment information Operating System: Platform: linux Arch: x64 Version: Ubuntu 20.04.0 LTS Fri Feb 24 2023 12:23:18 GMT+0200 (Eastern European Standard Time) Binaries: Node: 16.14.2 npm: 7.17.0 Yarn: 1.22.19 pnpm: 7.13.6 Relevant packages: next: 13.2.1 eslint-config-next: N/A react: 18.2.0 react-dom: 18.2.0 ### Which area(s) of Next.js are affected? (leave empty if unsure) App directory (appDir: true) ### Link to the code that reproduces this issue https://stackblitz.com/edit/vercel-next-js-gqeapg?file=package.json,app%2F[variant]%2F(shop)%2Fp%2F[[...id]]%2Fpage.tsx,next.config.js ### To Reproduce Try to import cookies from `next/headers` Try to access a dynamic page, eg `/test/p` ### Describe the Bug Error: Invariant: Method expects to have requestAsyncStorage, none available This happens if I do an import of cookies ``` import { cookies } from 'next/headers'; const DynamicPage = async () => { const nextCookies = cookies(); console.log(nextCookies.get('random')); const data = await loadRandomData(); return
{data.title}
; }; ``` ![Screenshot 2023-02-24 at 12 26 31](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/695515/221155519-8a149462-8b68-4db5-9a0e-75004f75a8b9.png) ### Expected Behavior I can access the cookies object on a dynamic page ### Which browser are you using? (if relevant) _No response_ ### How are you deploying your application? (if relevant) _No response_ [NEXT-644](https://linear.app/vercel/issue/NEXT-644/cookies-broke-on-1321-invariant-method-expects-to-have)
